articles.title: Some Black Holes Are Actually Second-Generation — Born from Other Black Holes!
articles.summary: Did you know some black holes might have been born from other black holes? Scientists at MIT found that about 14% of merging black holes could be “second-generation” — made when two smaller black holes crashed together. That’s like a cosmic family tree!

articles.title: Green Day’s Billie Joe Armstrong Forms a Punk Supergroup to Celebrate the Ramones!
articles.summary: Get ready to rock! Green Day’s Billie Joe Armstrong is teaming up with punk legends from Rancid, Blink-182, and the Ramones to form a new supergroup called Cretin Family. They’ll play a huge tribute concert on August 30 at a cemetery in Hollywood — and it’s all for a good cause!

articles.title: Why Does Everything Keep Turning Into Crabs? Scientists Are Figuring It Out!
articles.summary: Have you ever heard that animals keep evolving into crabs? It’s true! Scientists call it “carcinization.” A new study found that the sideways walk most crabs use probably evolved just once. But the crab shape itself popped up many times — even in animals that aren’t true crabs!
